description:
This file defines the Weight class in the Opencart uild
generated namespace that manages weight conversions, formatting, and retrieval of unit data for the cart system.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: Class that manages weight conversion, formatting, and retrieval in the cart system

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database and configuration objects, and loads weight class data from the database

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a weight value from one weight class to another using stored conversion factors

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a weight value as a string with proper unit and decimal/thousand separators

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string corresponding to a specific weight class
